basic_info.description: Welcome to this gracious, beautifully updated full-floor 2 bedroom residence located on a charming block in Corona Hts at the border of Castro/Eureka Valley! Brimming w/ old-world charm & modern luxuries, this fast-track condo-eligible TIC is not to be missed. Behind a classic facade in a lovely 2-unit building, this bright & spacious full-floor residence boasts high ceilings, large windows & period details that create a warm ambiance. The newly remodeled kitchen w/ center breakfast island is a chef's dream featuring sleek cabinetry, gleaming quartz countertops & all-new stainless steel appliances & seamlessly flows into an adjacent comfortable living/dining area that makes everyday living easy. The bathroom has also been stylishly updated w/ stunning  contemporary finishes & the refinished Douglas fir floors throughout add timeless sophistication. The residence also features all-new windows and new heating system. Additional highlights include a spacious in-unit laundry room, a beautifully landscaped shared backyard, & ample private basement storage. With the best of the Castro & Market Street just a short stroll away, this location offers EZ access to vibrant shops, eateries, public transit, & freeways making it ideal for the modern urban lifestyle!
